note: Let alpha=BD/DC, beta=CE/EA, gamma=AF/FB. Relative to affine basis A,B,C, section formulas give D=(0,1/(1+alpha),alpha/(1+alpha)), E=(beta/(1+beta),0,1/(1+beta)), F=(1/(1+gamma),gamma/(1+gamma),0). Thus AD is z=alpha y, BE is x=beta z, CF is y=gamma x. AD and BE have the unique intersection P=(alpha beta,1,alpha)/(alpha beta+1+alpha), which is on CF iff 1=alpha beta gamma.
